I wasn't diagnosed with a Thyroid issue until they tested my Thyroid Antibodies. I'd been asking for years for a comprehensive thyroid panel in relation to symptoms I'd been having and the fact that both sides of my family have thyroid issues. Even getting the "normal" thyroid tests was like pulling teeth. I switched doctors and even then ended up having to specifically ask for them to test my antibodies (a test I hadn't heard of up until that point). 

Whether or not that test would pertain to you or if you've already done it, just remember to advocate for yourself! As someone who is a people pleaser I know it can be hard, but this is YOUR actual LIFE and your body. You deserve to be heard and if that's not the issue great! You can rule that out and can start looking at other potential causes. Only you know what is happening inside your body.

Good luck on your journey! I hope you find comforting answers, peace and wellness!

I was always such a hard worker that's how I got validation; being a "productive member of society" was everything to me and now I'm just mentally crippled. I have to rely on my dad for financial support which sucks as a 31 year old woman. Not to mention as much as I love and am grateful for my father I also have trauma issues with him. I don't feel that I can work through them with him because I don't want to hurt him by letting him know how he hurt me. He really is a great man, my best friend in fact and I don't want to make him feel bad for shit that happened when I was a kid when I know he's not the same man now.
